# Orb UI inspiration

Luvani's native `OrbSurface.tsx` adapts the soft cloud visual concept and
separate listening / speaking signals from [exprmntl/orb-ui](https://github.com/exprmntl/orb-ui).
Reviewed source: `4d8bed99f9c626a88d97e4e3a30e00746b76860d` (9 October 2026).
Copyright © 2026 Alexander Chen. The upstream MIT license is included beside this notice.

This is an original native SVG and Animated implementation, rather than the
upstream browser canvas renderer. The existing Luvani LiveKit room, directional
audio meters, reduced-motion preferences, pause and background lifecycle remain
the source of truth. No upstream executable script or provider adapter is run.
